free_tier.stated: KVM2GB at AUD 20 / month, on a page that states 'Prices in AUD, including GST': 2 CPU cores, 2 GB RAM, 30 GB SSD, 1 TB/month data, 1 IPv4 plus a routed /64 IPv6. The same plans and prices are offered in all eight locations: Perth, Adelaide, Melbourne, Sydney, Brisbane, Auckland, Singapore and Tokyo. KVM4GB is AUD 50 / month with 4 cores, 4 GB, 50 GB SSD and 1.5 TB; KVM8GB is AUD 95 with 4 cores, 8 GB, 100 GB and 2 TB. The store's category page in its AUD view prints 'Starting from $20.00 AUD Monthly' for KVM2GB, with $50.00 AUD on KVM4GB and $95.00 AUD on KVM8GB, each with an Order Now button and no stock badge; the same page in its USD view prints $20.00 USD, so both currency views carry the same number and the USD figure is the vendor's set price, not a market conversion. The product page redirects anonymous visits to the category, and no annual, quarterly or renewal price is published on any page reachable without an account.

egress.terms: 1 TB a month on KVM2GB, counted in both directions, with the plan speed-restricted on exhaustion rather than suspended; no per-TB overage price is published, only 'contact us'
egress.free_allowance: 1 TB a month, inbound and outbound counted equally

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
tooling: KVM with a VPS control panel, self-service reverse DNS, custom ISO on request and resizing at any time; no API was read
chaining: The only Australian and APAC presence among documented hosts, at one price across eight cities including Singapore and Tokyo, which makes it the node to place where latency to an Asia-Pacific target matters. At 1 TB counted both ways it is a front end with a presence, not a transfer or storage node.

limits.value: 1 TB a month, and the page states 'Inbound and outbound data count equally. When a VPS reaches its data limit, its speed is restricted.' The allowance therefore throttles rather than suspends, but it counts both directions, so a mirror or a serving node spends it twice as fast as a pull-only crawler.
